title: Keep the Wheels Turning
brief: Create an eight-slide proposal titled Keep the Wheels Turning for Tern, a fictional independent bicycle workshop proposing a simple maintenance membership to its local customers. Explain the customer problem, what is included, what is excluded, a three-step member journey, a comparison of two clearly fictional sample plans, a native editable chart using explicitly illustrative quarterly visit counts 12, 18, 25 and 30, a realistic launch timeline, and a clear next step. Use useful speaker notes and concise persuasive content. Choose a distinctive visual identity for Tern. Keep native text, shapes and chart editable in PowerPoint. Do not invent testimonials, real results or working checkout links.
